mechanism: Vitamin C reduces methotrexate efficacy by competing for active renal tubular secretion and increasing urinary methotrexate excretion, while high-dose vitamin C may increase methotrexate crystallization risk in renal tubules.
action: Monitor methotrexate efficacy; avoid high-dose vitamin C supplementation (>2g daily) concurrent with methotrexate therapy; separate administration timing if possible and maintain adequate hydration.
